column1: Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for SC Students
column2: Tuition and non-refundable fees plus academic allowance of Rs 86,000 in year 1 and Rs 41,000 in later years
column3: SC students who passed Class 12 and are admitted to a full-time course at a notified top institution; family income up to Rs 8 lakh
column4: Caste certificate; income certificate; bank account; admission rank; fee details

column1: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students (West Bengal, OASIS)
column2: Post-matric tuition and maintenance support for SC students in West Bengal
column3: West Bengal domicile SC students who passed the previous year's final exam and are studying within India; family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh
column4: Caste certificate; income certificate; birth certificate or Madhyamik admit card; mark sheet; bank passbook first page; Aadhaar; photograph; residential certificate; declaration of income
